name: AUTOPILOT.OI Bookkeeping Sorter
description_html:
Your receipts, sorted. No spreadsheets, no AI skills.

Upload your bank or card statement into the free Claude app, type sort, and every transaction lands in a clear business category with totals: supplies, gas, software, ads, personal and more. When it isn't sure, it asks you instead of guessing.

How it works: you add the guide to a free Claude Project, paste one message, answer 7 easy questions, then type one word whenever you need it. It drafts; you decide.

What you type: sort · receipts · month · year · rule

What you get (13 page guide, PDF): a setup helper that asks 7 easy questions and sets it up with you in about 15 minutes, tap by tap on your phone, a worked example, a cheat sheet, how to download a statement from your bank, and a monthly checklist.

You need: the Claude app (the free plan works), one bank or card statement.

Not tax, legal or accounting advice: your accountant has the final say. Never upload full card numbers or passwords. 30 day refund: reply to your receipt.

AUTOPILOT.OI is independent and not affiliated with Anthropic. Claude is a product of Anthropic.
